_comment: Editor layout for the MaxEnt hydrodynamic-radius FCS model (MaxEntRHModel). Same inversion as maxent_fcs.view.json, but the grid is a size axis: w0 and the sample temperature turn each diffusion time into a radius, so they get their own panel — get either wrong and the distribution is in the wrong units, not merely the wrong shape.

sections.label: Prior
sections.description: Entropy prior: what the recovered distribution is pulled toward where the data say nothing. 'uniform' is flat ignorance (the historical behaviour); 'lognormal' centres the prior on the radius grid at prior_c with a width of prior_w decades -- the inversion then reports the data's deviations from that expectation rather than from flatness.
reg is log10 of the entropy weight. rh_min/rh_max/n_rh set the log-spaced radius grid the distribution is recovered on; s is the structure parameter and b the baseline.
The beam waist and the sample temperature convert a diffusion time into a hydrodynamic radius (Stokes-Einstein through the water viscosity).

sections.title: L-curve
sections.description: Regularization sweep: the corner is the weight that balances misfit against the smoothness of the recovered distribution.
Press sweep to sample the weight over the range shown, then click a point (or 'corner') to adopt its weight.
